description: This file defines interfaces related to system information and subsystem management within the Thunder plugin framework. It includes interface definitions for metadata, subsystem status, security, internet, location, identification, time, provisioning, and decryption, along with associated enums and notification mechanisms.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface providing access to system metadata such as build hash and version numbers.

classes.name: ISubSystem
classes.description: Interface for managing and querying various system subsystems and their statuses, including notifications and version info.

methods.name: BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree of the system.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version string of the subsystem.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for subsystem updates.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the state or information for a specific subsystem.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the current state or information for a specific subsystem.

methods.name: IsActive
methods.description: Checks if a specific subsystem is active.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Template method to query specific interface implementations from the subsystem.
